connector.name: 1Claw Vault
connector.registryDescription: HSM-backed vault secrets for AI agents (JIT fetch) plus prompt-injection and threat scanning.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the 1clawai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ONECLAW_AGENT_API_KEY
env.description: Agent API key (ocv_...). Exchanged for a short-lived JWT; auto-discovers agent ID and vault. Recommended for stdio.

env.name: ONECLAW_AGENT_ID
env.description: Optional agent UUID when pinning identity (usually auto-discovered from the API key).

env.name: ONECLAW_VAULT_ID
env.description: Optional vault UUID when the agent can access multiple vaults.

env.name: ONECLAW_LOCAL_ONLY
env.description: Set to true for security-only mode (inspect_content only; no vault credentials).
